comps.label: C1

comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; fiber broadband is a small part.

comps.label: C4

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Alaska integrated carrier with wireless and cable video; the fiber, wholesale and enterprise overlap is real but regionally narrow, and wireless is central.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber network selling residential broadband, business data and wholesale carrier fiber transport; same model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Fiber broadband and wireline telecom for residential and business customers, with wholesale access and tower leasing; similar asset-owning model.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Satellite broadband and defense equipment maker; different technology, manufacturing and government systems revenue.
